Asked Codex to create a simple web page with a single image in the middle, with the same background as the image b/c I'm lazy

Got to work, worked 3 minutes

Came back asking if it can install a gazillion node modules

I would have been faster typing out those 5 HTML lines myself

It installed Nextjs, ESlint, tests, even Drizzle (!!)

Hurts me to think how many tokens wasted, but at least it was only 3 minutes

... and it STILL got the background color wrong!!

Just used Chrome dev tools to sample the color, update the HTML

You know what I'll just hand roll simple stuff next time. I guess I'm still better than the model at this, ha!
